title: feat(waterjet): Waterjet Profile operation on a shared 2D sheet kernel
body:
## What changed

- **Shared 2D sheet kernel (`crates/motion/src/sheet/`).** The kernel code moves out of `plasma` and `wire_edm` without a change of behaviour:
  - `nest` (contour roles, inner-first cut order) and `ring` (kerf ring, walks), from `plasma`;
  - `laws` (kerf law, cover law) and `lead` (straight and arc leads), from `plasma`;
  - `arclen` (a ring by arc length), from `wire_edm::tabs`;
  - `open` (the one-sided offset of an open run), from `wire_edm::open`.

  A `Voice` keeps each refusal text word for word. Plasma and wire EDM now call the shared code.
- **Cover law.** The law now takes one span or more for each contour, and an `exempt` closure for a tab's bridge. Plasma exempts no point. The law now refuses a closed contour that has no span.
- **Waterjet generator (`crates/motion/src/waterjet/`).** `waterjet_profile` does these steps:
  - It cuts the inner contours first, with the kerf ring at kerf / 2 on the waste side.
  - It adds straight or arc leads, with the pierce in the scrap. A lead with no room is halved up to four times.
  - It pierces a tight hole at its centre when the lead has no room after the halving.
  - It cuts tabs as uncut gaps. Each stretch between two gaps gets its own pierce, lead-in and lead-out.
  - It cuts open runs on the centre line, or to the left or right of travel.
  - It can post G41/G42, and it can send arcs as chords (`Move::chords`).

  The kerf law and the cover law certify the result.
- **App.** The changes are:
  - `OpType::WaterjetProfile` (stored id 46; main holds 44 for Slot Undercut and 45 for V-Carve), `Section::Waterjet` and `Family::Waterjet`. The op mounts a `ToolKind::Waterjet` nozzle only.
  - `WaterjetOp` with its command-door sanity check, `waterjet_op.rs` (seed, params, generate) and the digest bytes.
  - A `.camproj` DTO (`waterjet_profile`, additive).
  - Each exhaustive match in the app gets a waterjet arm.
  - Profile (DXF) sources are admitted. The family door has its own words: "mount a waterjet first".
  - MCP reaches the kind through the generic `add_operation` / `edit_operation`. The `add_operation` text now names waterjet.
- **UI.** The changes are:
  - `waterjet_page.rs` with these fields: kerf, compensation, direction, open-run side, send arcs as lines, sheet heights, tabs, lead shape and lengths, cut feed, pierce time, abrasive delay. It has no torch height or THC field.
  - The Waterjet ribbon section.
  - An original glyph (`assets/ui/svg/op-waterjet-profile.svg`, rasterised by `cargo xtask icons`).

## Readings

- Golden `waterjet_tabbed_plate_with_holes.cl` has 149 moves, 5 pierces and 3 holes cut before the outline. The outline is cut as two led-in stretches between 2 mm tabs.
- The existing goldens do not change. `git diff --stat upstream/main -- "*.nc" "*.cl"` shows only the new file. The plasma golden `plasma_plate_with_holes.cl` stays byte-identical after the kernel move.

## Goldens moved

- `crates/app/tests/golden/waterjet_tabbed_plate_with_holes.cl`: **new file**. It records the first waterjet program: a plate with three holes and two tabs on the outline. The holes are cut before the outline. Each pierce is in the scrap. The kerf ring is 0.4 mm on the waste side. No existing recorded program changes.
- Run on the final head `e85e4a88b`: `golden_cl` (34 passed), `example_catalog` (37 passed, 4 ignored in debug), `example_catalog_adaptive` (1 passed), `example_catalog_edge_work` (1 passed). `git diff --stat upstream/main...HEAD -- "*.nc" "*.cl" examples/catalog` shows only the new file.

## Tests (pins)

Each pin was red before this change: the module and the kind did not exist, so the pins could not compile.

- motion `waterjet::tests` (9): `holes_are_cut_before_the_outline_and_every_pierce_is_in_the_waste`, `straight_leads_lay_no_arc_on_a_square_part`, `tabs_leave_uncut_gaps_and_each_stretch_is_pierced_and_led_in`, `a_tight_hole_is_pierced_at_its_centre`, `linearize_sends_every_arc_as_chords`, `an_open_run_rides_its_stated_side`, `control_compensation_records_a_comp_span_per_untabbed_contour`, `bad_input_is_refused_by_name`, `a_slot_narrower_than_the_kerf_is_refused_not_bridged`.
- app `waterjet_profile` (6): the family door, hole first, tabs, a milling tool refused, create / edit / undo / redo, and a byte-identical `.camproj` round trip.
- app `mcp_waterjet` (1): add, edit, undo, redo and generate over MCP.
- app `golden_cl::waterjet_tabbed_plate_with_holes_matches_golden`.
- ui `waterjet_ribbon_tests` (2): the section shows on a waterjet only, the tip names the waterjet, the glyph is its own, and the page has a leads tab.
- Plasma and wire EDM: all `camcraft-motion` plasma, sheet and wire tests pass, and all 34 `golden_cl` tests pass.

## Mutation results

Each mutation was applied, the pins were run, and then the code was restored (green again).

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| Inner-first order removed | red: `holes_are_cut_before_...`, `a_tight_hole_...` |
| Tabs ignored | red: `tabs_leave_uncut_gaps_...`, `bad_input_...` |
| Tight-hole rule off | red: `a_tight_hole_is_pierced_at_its_centre` |
| Linearization ignored | red: `linearize_sends_every_arc_as_chords` |
| Cover law exempts every point | red: `a_slot_narrower_than_the_kerf_is_refused_not_bridged` |
| Cover law exempts no point | red: `tabs_leave_uncut_gaps_...` (6 mm tabs) |
| Leads on the part side | red: 7 of 9 pins |

## Gate

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 422 steps ran (374 app, 44 post, 3 motion, 1 cl). The only red steps were kind-count pins that this change extends on purpose: `lathe_voice::tests::every_kind_is_work_spindle_live_tool_or_refused_by_name`, `operation::tests::stamp_follows_every_input` and `tests/ribbon.rs` (`family_is_derived_not_forked`, `the_probe_appends_its_id_and_lists_in_drilling`). I updated them to 45 kinds and the Waterjet section. Because I edited during the run, the gate marked that run VOID. `--failed` on the committed tree then ran the red step: green. The app lib suite is green (290).
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`: 1324 passed, 0 failed. The waterjet row was added to `tips_match_the_imgui_table`.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: green.

- Review fix on `aded58c47` (merged with `upstream/main` `f036dddad`):
  - `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 694 steps, 1 failed. The red step is `app suites: tool_gate` (`the_refusal_names_a_fitting_catalog_entry`). Its red row is `OpType::Finish3D`: `upstream/main` (#3069) adds `Router ball nose 6 mm` before `BN-0600` in the catalog, and the tie goes to the first entry. The step is red on `upstream/main` too. The waterjet row in the same test passes.
  - `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: 237 steps, 0 failed. The lanes are `motion heavy` (37 steps), `app heavy` (199 steps) and the heavy build.
  - `cargo clippy -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: green.

- Review fix on `aded58c47`, round 3. The final head is `e85e4a88b`, merged with `upstream/main` `f35202134`:
  - The merge resolved 17 conflicts by hand and kept both sides in each hunk. `job.rs` keeps main's `wire_sketch.is_none()` guard and adds the waterjet arm. Waterjet Profile moved to the free stored id 46. `pick_kinds.rs` (new on main) gives it `PICK_OWED`, as for plasma.
  - `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 742 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (48.1 min).
  - `the_refusal_names_a_fitting_catalog_entry` passes. Main fixed the Finish3D row in `3f945362a` (the size tie now breaks by name).
  - Stored id pin: `operation::tests::stamp_follows_every_input`. Mutation: id 44 for Waterjet gives RED ("row 46 out of step with ordinal"). The restored id 46 gives GREEN.
  - `cargo xtask gate light`: 3 steps, 0 failed.
  - `cargo clippy -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: green.
  - The full heavy lanes did not run again for this round. AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review" (#3556) retires them at review: they run at the cut. This PR is P4, so no targeted heavy step applies. The last heavy run on `aded58c47` had 237 steps and 0 failed.

## Not exercised

- Posting. No post serves `Kind::Waterjet` yet. The pierce time and the abrasive delay are in the path notes only. #1882 adds the CL record and the post hooks.
- `verify` and the post gate for a waterjet op. That is #1885.
- Selection of the cut data from the nozzle's recipe. This is follow-up #3047.
- The MCP skill row. The skill file is a protected path in this session. This is follow-up #3048.
- The UI page was not opened in an interactive window. The screenshots below come from the off-screen egui_kittest and wgpu render of the real shell.

## Overlaps

- These open PRs also append an op kind to the same enums and tables (`kinds.rs`, `types/params.rs`, `project/params*.rs`): #2920, #2890, #2836, #2831, #2716, #2714. The conflicts are additive (both sides add arms). The PR that merges second takes the next free stored id.
- These open PRs touch `generate.rs` or `job.rs`, in other functions: #2997, #2822, #2678, #2999, #2993, #2992, #2981, #2979, #2978. The PR that merges second refreshes.
- #2932 touches `crates/ui/src/interact.rs`, in other functions.

Decisions: `docs/decisions/1883-waterjet-profile.md`.

Effort: max

Changelog: Waterjet Profile operation - inner-first 2D through-cuts with kerf offset, straight or arc leads pierced in the scrap, tabs as uncut gaps (each stretch led in and out straight, and a lead that cuts a tab's bridge is refused), the tight-hole centre pierce, open-run sides, optional G41/G42 and arc linearization; plasma and wire EDM now share one 2D sheet kernel.

Fixes #1883
